name: atlasfold_predict
description: Predict an all-atom protein structure with AtlasFold v1.0.0. Give one sequence in 'chains' for a monomer, or several for one complex (folded by the AtlasFold-M multimer head). Returns per-sample confidence scores (avg_plddt, pTM) and which sample ranked best; the mmCIF text itself is opt-in. Protein only -- this model has no ligand, DNA or RNA input.

chains.description: The amino-acid sequences of one target. One element folds through the monomer head; two or more are one complex folded through the multimer head.

name.description: A label for the target; appears in the output names.

seeds.description: Random seeds. Each seed produces num_samples structures, so total structures is seeds x num_samples. Upstream's default is the single seed 1.

num_samples.description: Diffusion samples per seed (upstream's default is 5). Each is scored separately, so this is how to compare conformations; rank them on `scores`.

num_recycles.description: Recycling iterations (upstream's default is 4 for a monomer, 10 for a multimer). More costs time, not memory.

num_steps.description: Diffusion sampling steps. Omit for upstream's own length-dependent default (20 up to 512 tokens, 30 to 1024, 100 above; 200 for a multimer).

return_structures.description: Return the structure text (default false: an all-atom file of a few hundred residues is megabytes). The confidence scores come back either way.
